excerpt.zh: 过境的宇宙风暴留下的不仅仅是毁灭。在[Planet.GetName]上，它还创造了一个全新的地理特征。
excerpt.en: A passing cosmic storm has left more than mere devastation in its wake. On [Planet.GetName], it has created an entirely new geographical feature.
